function SidebarContent({ collapsed, onToggleCollapse, onNavClick }: any) {
  const location = useLocation();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const { user, logout } = useAuth();

  const handleGoHome = () => { navigate('/'); onNavClick?.(); };
  const handleLogout = () => { logout(); navigate('/login'); onNavClick?.(); };

  const navItems = (user?.role ? (navConfig as Record<string, any>)[user.role] : undefined) || safeStaffNav;
  const language = user?.settings?.language || 'en';
  const [myHealthOpen, setMyHealthOpen] = useState(true);
  const [mindOpen, setMindOpen] = useState(true);
  const [myWellnessOpen, setMyWellnessOpen] = useState(true);

  return (
    <div className={`flex flex-col h-full bg-sidebar text-sidebar-foreground ${collapsed ? 'w-[72px]' : 'w-64'}`}>
      {/* Logo */}
      <div className={`flex items-center gap-3 px-4 py-5 border-b border-sidebar-border ${collapsed ? 'justify-center' : ''}`}>
        <img src="/logo.png" alt="FindMedi Logo" className="w-12 h-12 object-contain drop-shadow-md flex-shrink-0 rounded-xl" />
        {!collapsed && (
          <div>
            <h1 className="font-heading text-base font-bold text-sidebar-primary-foreground leading-none">FindMedi</h1>
            <p className="text-[10px] text-sidebar-foreground/50 mt-0.5">Portal</p>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* User card */}
      {!collapsed && user && (
        <div className="mx-3 mt-3 p-3 bg-sidebar-accent/60 rounded-xl border border-sidebar-border/50">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
            <div className="w-8 h-8 rounded-lg bg-sidebar-primary flex items-center justify-center text-sidebar-primary-foreground text-xs font-bold flex-shrink-0">
              {user.name?.charAt(0).toUpperCase()}
            </div>
            <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
              <p className="text-sm font-medium text-sidebar-foreground truncate">{user.name}</p>
              <span className={`text-[10px] font-semibold px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded-full capitalize ${(user.role && (roleBadgeColor as Record<string, string>)[user.role]) || 'bg-muted text-muted-foreground'}`}>
                {t(`role.${user.role}`, language)}
              </span>
            </div>
            <NotificationBell />
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Navigation */}
      <nav className="sidebar-nav min-h-0 flex-1 py-3 px-2 space-y-0.5 overflow-y-auto overscroll-contain">
        {navItems.map((item: any, idx: number) => {
          const { icon: Icon, labelKey, path, isHealth, isMind, isMyWellness } = item;
          const currentFull = location.pathname + (location.search || '');
          let isActive = false;
          if (path.startsWith('/mind/user?tab=')) {
            isActive = currentFull === path;
          } else if (path.includes('?tab=approve')) {
            isActive = location.pathname.includes('/online-appointments') && (location.search === '?tab=approve' || location.search === '?tab=pending' || !location.search);
          } else if (path.includes('?tab=approved')) {
            isActive = location.pathname.includes('/online-appointments') && (location.search === '?tab=approved' || location.search === '?tab=today' || location.search === '?tab=upcoming');
          } else if (path.includes('?tab=history')) {
            isActive = location.pathname.includes('/online-appointments') && (location.search === '?tab=history' || location.search === '?tab=complete');
          } else if (path === '/clinic/appointments' || path === '/doctor/appointments') {
            isActive = (location.pathname === path || location.pathname === `${path}/upcoming` || location.pathname === `${path}/approved`) && !location.search;
          } else if (path.includes('?')) {
            isActive = currentFull === path;
          } else if (path === '/mind/counsellor' || path === '/mind/psychiatrist') {
            isActive = location.pathname === path && !location.search;
          } else {
            isActive = location.pathname === path;
          }
          const label = t(labelKey, language);

          const isFirstHealth = isHealth && (idx === 0 || !navItems[idx - 1]?.isHealth);
          const isFirstMind = isMind && (idx === 0 || !navItems[idx - 1]?.isMind);
          const isFirstMyWellness = isMyWellness && (idx === 0 || !navItems[idx - 1]?.isMyWellness);

          if (isHealth && !myHealthOpen && !collapsed && !isActive) {
            return isFirstHealth ? (
              <div key="health-header-collapsed" className="pt-2 pb-1">
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setMyHealthOpen(true)}
                  className="w-full flex items-center justify-between px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-rose-500 hover:bg-rose-500/10 rounded-xl transition-all"
                >
                  <span className="flex items-center gap-2">
                    <Heart className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-rose-500" />
                    <span>My Health</span>
                  </span>
                  <ChevronRight className="w-3.5 h-3.5 transition-transform duration-200" />
                </button>
              </div>
            ) : null;
          }

          if (isMind && !mindOpen && !collapsed && !isActive) {
            return isFirstMind ? (
              <div key="mind-header-collapsed" className="pt-2 pb-1">
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setMindOpen(true)}
                  className="w-full flex items-center justify-between px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-violet-500 hover:bg-violet-500/10 rounded-xl transition-all"
                >
                  <span className="flex items-center gap-2">
                    <Brain className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-violet-500" />
                    <span>Mindsupport</span>
                  </span>
                  <ChevronRight className="w-3.5 h-3.5 transition-transform duration-200" />
                </button>
              </div>
            ) : null;
          }

          if (isMyWellness && !myWellnessOpen && !collapsed && !isActive) {
            return isFirstMyWellness ? (
              <div key="mywellness-header-collapsed" className="pt-2 pb-1">
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setMyWellnessOpen(true)}
                  className="w-full flex items-center justify-between px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-teal-500 hover:bg-teal-500/10 rounded-xl transition-all"
                >
                  <span className="flex items-center gap-2">
                    <Heart className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-teal-500" />
                    <span>My Wellness</span>
                  </span>
                  <ChevronRight className="w-3.5 h-3.5 transition-transform duration-200" />
                </button>
              </div>
            ) : null;
          }

          const showSection = item.section && (idx === 0 || navItems[idx - 1]?.section !== item.section);

          return (
            <React.Fragment key={`${path}-${labelKey}-${idx}`}>
              {showSection && !collapsed && (
                <div className="pt-3 pb-1 px-3 text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-muted-foreground">{item.section}</div>
              )}
              {isFirstMyWellness && (
                <div className="pt-2 pb-1">
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => setMyWellnessOpen(!myWellnessOpen)}
                    title={collapsed ? "My Wellness" : undefined}
                    className={`w-full flex items-center justify-between px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-teal-500 hover:bg-teal-500/10 rounded-xl transition-all ${collapsed ? 'justify-center' : ''}`}
                  >
                    <span className="flex items-center gap-2">
                      <Heart className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-teal-500" />
                      {!collapsed && <span>My Wellness</span>}
                    </span>
                    {!collapsed && (
                      <ChevronRight className={`w-3.5 h-3.5 transition-transform duration-200 ${myWellnessOpen ? 'rotate-90' : ''}`} />
                    )}
                  </button>
                </div>
              )}
              {isFirstMind && (
                <div className="pt-2 pb-1">
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => setMindOpen(!mindOpen)}
                    title={collapsed ? "Mindsupport" : undefined}
                    className={`w-full flex items-center justify-between px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-violet-500 hover:bg-violet-500/10 rounded-xl transition-all ${collapsed ? 'justify-center' : ''}`}
                  >
                    <span className="flex items-center gap-2">
                      <Brain className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-violet-500" />
                      {!collapsed && <span>Mindsupport</span>}
                    </span>
                    {!collapsed && (
                      <ChevronRight className={`w-3.5 h-3.5 transition-transform duration-200 ${mindOpen ? 'rotate-90' : ''}`} />
                    )}
                  </button>
                </div>
              )}
              {isFirstHealth && (
                <div className="pt-2 pb-1">
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => setMyHealthOpen(!myHealthOpen)}
                    title={collapsed ? "My Health" : undefined}
                    className={`w-full flex items-center justify-between px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-rose-500 hover:bg-rose-500/10 rounded-xl transition-all ${collapsed ? 'justify-center' : ''}`}
                  >
                    <span className="flex items-center gap-2">
                      <Heart className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-rose-500" />
                      {!collapsed && <span>My Health</span>}
                    </span>
                    {!collapsed && (
                      <ChevronRight className={`w-3.5 h-3.5 transition-transform duration-200 ${myHealthOpen ? 'rotate-90' : ''}`} />
                    )}
                  </button>
                </div>
              )}
              {labelKey === 'common.logout' ? (
                <button onClick={() => { handleLogout(); onNavClick?.(); }}
                  title={collapsed ? label : undefined}
                  className={`sidebar-link flex items-center gap-3 px-3 py-2.5 rounded-xl transition-all duration-200 group text-sidebar-foreground/65 hover:bg-sidebar-accent hover:text-sidebar-accent-foreground w-full text-left ${collapsed ? 'justify-center' : ''}`}>
                  <Icon className="w-[18px] h-[18px] flex-shrink-0 group-hover:scale-110 transition-transform" />
                  {!collapsed && <span className="text-sm font-medium">{label}</span>}
                </button>
              ) : (
                <Link to={path} onClick={onNavClick}
                  title={collapsed ? label : undefined}
                  className={`sidebar-link flex items-center gap-3 px-3 py-2.5 rounded-xl transition-all duration-200 group ${isActive ? 'bg-sidebar-primary text-sidebar-primary-foreground shadow-lg shadow-sidebar-primary/20' : 'text-sidebar-foreground/65 hover:bg-sidebar-accent hover:text-sidebar-accent-foreground'} ${collapsed ? 'justify-center' : ''} ${isHealth && !collapsed ? 'ml-2 pl-3 border-l border-rose-500/30' : ''} ${isMind && !collapsed ? 'ml-2 pl-3 border-l border-violet-500/30' : ''} ${isMyWellness && !collapsed ? 'ml-2 pl-3 border-l border-teal-500/30' : ''}`}>
                  <Icon className={`w-[18px] h-[18px] flex-shrink-0 ${!isActive ? 'group-hover:scale-110 transition-transform' : ''}`} />
                  {!collapsed && <span className="text-sm font-medium">{label}</span>}
                </Link>
              )}
            </React.Fragment>
          );
        })}
      </nav>

      {/* Footer */}
      <div className={`px-2 pb-4 border-t border-sidebar-border pt-3 space-y-1 ${collapsed ? 'flex flex-col items-center' : ''}`}>
        <button onClick={handleGoHome}
          title={collapsed ? t('nav.home', language) : undefined}
          className={`sidebar-link flex items-center gap-3 px-3 py-2.5 rounded-xl text-sidebar-foreground/65 hover:text-sidebar-foreground hover:bg-sidebar-accent transition-all duration-200 w-full ${collapsed ? 'justify-center' : ''}`}>
          <Home className="w-[18px] h-[18px] flex-shrink-0" />
          {!collapsed && <span className="text-sm">{t('nav.home', language)}</span>}
        </button>
        <button onClick={handleLogout}
          title={collapsed ? t('common.logout', language) : undefined}
          className={`sidebar-link flex items-center gap-3 px-3 py-2.5 rounded-xl text-sidebar-foreground/50 hover:text-sidebar-foreground hover:bg-sidebar-accent transition-all duration-200 w-full ${collapsed ? 'justify-center' : ''}`}>
          <LogOut className="w-[18px] h-[18px] flex-shrink-0" />
          {!collapsed && <span className="text-sm">{t('common.logout', language)}</span>}
        </button>
      </div>

      {/* Collapse Toggle - desktop only */}
      {onToggleCollapse && (
        <button
          onClick={onToggleCollapse}
          aria-label={collapsed ? 'Expand sidebar' : 'Collapse sidebar'}
          className="absolute -right-3 top-[72px] w-6 h-6 rounded-full bg-primary text-primary-foreground flex items-center justify-center shadow-md hover:scale-110 transition-transform z-10 max-md:hidden"
        >
          {collapsed ? <ChevronRight className="w-3 h-3" /> : <ChevronLeft className="w-3 h-3" />}
        </button>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

export default function AppSidebar() {
  const [collapsed, setCollapsed] = useState(false);
  const [sheetOpen, setSheetOpen] = useState(false);
  const isMobile = useIsMobile();

  if (isMobile) {
    return (
      <>
        <button onClick={() => setSheetOpen(true)}
          className="fixed top-3 left-3 z-50 w-10 h-10 rounded-xl bg-sidebar text-sidebar-foreground flex items-center justify-center shadow-lg hover:bg-sidebar-accent transition-colors">
          <Menu className="w-5 h-5" />
        </button>
        <Sheet open={sheetOpen} onOpenChange={setSheetOpen}>
<SheetContent side="left" className="p-0 w-[280px] bg-sidebar border-r border-sidebar-border">
          <SheetTitle className="sr-only">Navigation Menu</SheetTitle>
          <SheetDescription className="sr-only">Mobile navigation sidebar</SheetDescription>
          <SidebarContent collapsed={false} onNavClick={() => setSheetOpen(false)} />
        </SheetContent>
        </Sheet>
      </>
    );
  }

  return (
    <aside className="sidebar-motion fixed left-0 top-0 h-screen z-50 shadow-2xl transition-all duration-300 max-md:hidden">
      <SidebarContent collapsed={collapsed} onToggleCollapse={() => setCollapsed(!collapsed)} />
    </aside>
  );
}

import { HeartPulse, BedDouble, Ambulance, Microscope, Pill, Smile, Eye, Flower2, Activity, Dumbbell, ShieldCheck, CheckCircle2, Clock, Sparkles, Search, Droplets, Phone, FileText, Home, Baby, Stethoscope, CalendarDays, Users, Truck, Package, Leaf, Repeat, HeartHandshake, ShieldAlert, Scissors, Glasses, Syringe, Timer, IndianRupee, MapPin, UserCheck, Waves, } from 'lucide-react'; import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button'; import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input'; export interface FacilityTypeSpecificProps { type: string; data: any; onAction?: (actionKey: string, payload?: any) => void; } export default function FacilityTypeSpecific({ type, data = {}, onAction }: FacilityTypeSpecificProps) { const normType = (type || 'hospital').toLowerCase(); // ── Hospital: Departments + Emergency + Beds ── if (normType === 'hospital') { const depts = data.departments || [ 'Cardiology & Cath Lab', 'Orthopaedics & Joint Replacement', 'Neurology & Neurosurgery', 'Gastroenterology & Hepatology', 'Paediatrics & Neonatology', 'Obstetrics & Gynaecology', 'Nephrology & Dialysis', 'Pulmonology & Critical Care', 'Oncology & Daycare Chemotherapy', 'General & Laparoscopic Surgery', ]; return (
{/* Emergency & Trauma Section */}

24x7 Emergency & Critical Trauma Unit

Dedicated emergency physicians, ICU, CCU, and rapid ambulance response

Trauma Level {data.traumaLevel || 'Level 1 Comprehensive'}
Emergency Helpline {data.emergencyPhone || '108 / +91-9876543210'}
Ambulance Fleet BLS & ALS On-Site
{/* Live Beds / Inpatient Capacity */}

Inpatient Ward Categories & Tariffs

General Ward

Shared room with nursing monitoring

₹{data.genWardRate || '1,200'} / day
Semi-Private / Private

Air-conditioned with attendant cot

₹{data.privateRate || '3,500'} / day
Intensive Care (ICU)

Multi-para monitoring & ventilator

₹{data.icuRate || '8,500'} / day
{/* Clinical Departments */}

Specialised Medical Departments

{depts.map((d: string, idx: number) => (
{d}
))}
); } // ── Blood Bank Availability Heatmap ── if (normType === 'blood_bank') { const groups = ['A+', 'A-', 'B+', 'B-', 'O+', 'O-', 'AB+', 'AB-']; return (

Live Blood Component Stock

Updated every 2 hours · Compliant with NACO & State Blood Transfusion Council

{groups.map((grp) => (
{grp} Available
))}

Components available: Whole Human Blood, Packed Red Blood Cells (PRBC), Fresh Frozen Plasma (FFP), Platelet Concentrate.

); } // ── Gym & Fitness Plans ── if (normType === 'gym') { return (

Membership Plans & Equipment

Monthly Pass

Full floor access, cardio + weights

₹1,500 / month
Popular Quarterly Pass

Floor access + 2 trainer sessions

₹3,800 / 3 months
Annual Unlimited

Full year + locker + steam bath

₹12,000 / year
{/* Peak Hours Graph preview */}
Typical Crowd Meter:
6 AM – 9 AM: Moderate · 9 AM – 5 PM: Quiet · 5 PM – 9 PM: Peak
); } // ── Dental Specialties & Sterilization ── if (normType === 'dental') { return (

Dental Specialities & Sterilization Protocol

Class-B Autoclave Sterilization

100% individual sealed sterilization pouches opened in front of patients.

In-house Digital OPG & X-Ray

Low radiation digital sensor radiography for instantaneous root diagnosis.

); } // ── Government Health Centre (PHC/CHC/Jan Aushadhi) ── if (normType === 'govt') { return (

Government Healthcare & Free Public Services

Free General OPD Consultations
Free Childhood & Maternal Immunisation
Essential Generic Medicines (Jan Aushadhi)
Free NCD & Diabetes Screenings

Information sourced from official govt portals · Last verified periodically · Claim this listing if you are facility staff

); } // ── Eye Hospital / Optical (spec §2.6) ── if (normType === 'eye') { const specialties = data.specialties || ['Cataract (Phaco)', 'Retina & Vitreous', 'Glaucoma', 'Cornea & Oculoplasty', 'Squint & Paediatric Ophthal', 'LASIK & Refractive']; return (

Eye Specialities, Technology & Optical Shop

Phaco emulsification · OCT · Fundus laser · Computerised vision testing

{specialties.map((s: string) => (
{s}
))}

From ₹{data.lasikPrice || '35,000'}

Optical shop on premises: frames & lenses from leading brands · Free eye-test with frame purchase · Prescription upload for powered lenses

); } // ── AYUSH Clinic / Panchakarma (spec §2.7) ── if (normType === 'ayush') { const system = data.systemOfMedicine || 'Ayurveda'; const treatments = data.treatments || [ { name: 'Panchakarma Detox (7 days)', duration: '7 days', price: '₹12,000' }, { name: 'Abhyanga full-body massage', duration: '60 min', price: '₹1,200' }, { name: 'Shirodhara stress therapy', duration: '45 min', price: '₹1,500' }, { name: 'Nadi Pariksha + consult', duration: '30 min', price: '₹400' }, ]; return (

{system} Treatments & Panchakarma

Practitioners with valid State Council registration (CCIM/NCISM)

{treatments.map((t: any) => (
{t.name} {t.duration}
{t.price}
))}
AYUSH therapies are complementary support, not a substitute for emergency or acute medical care. No cure claims are permitted on listings.
); } // ── Dialysis Centre (spec §2.8) ── if (normType === 'dialysis') { return (

Dialysis Shifts, Water Quality & Safety

Recurring slot booking · RO-treated dialysis-grade water · Isolation machines for HBV/HCV

Morning Shift

6:00 AM – 11:00 AM

Slots available
Afternoon Shift

12:00 PM – 5:00 PM

Limited slots
Evening Shift

5:00 PM – 10:00 PM

Slots available

); } // ── Yoga Studio (spec §2.14) ── if (normType === 'yoga') { const styles = data.styles || ['Hatha', 'Vinyasa Flow', 'Ashtanga', 'Prenatal Yoga', 'Therapeutic / Chair Yoga']; return (

Styles, Batch Timetable & Trial

Teachers certified by Yoga Certification Board (YCB), Ministry of AYUSH

{styles.map((s: string) => (
{s}
))}
Drop-in Class ₹300 / class
1st Class Free Trial Session Free
Monthly Unlimited ₹2,000 / month

Prenatal & therapy batches require doctor clearance · Online live sessions available · Women-only batch timings listed in timetable

); } // ── Wellness Centre / Spa (spec §2.15) ── if (normType === 'wellness') { return (

Wellness & spa services are non-medical. Contraindications (pregnancy, cardiac conditions) must be declared. No medical-cure claims are permitted.
); } // ── Equipment Rental / Medical Devices (spec §2.16) ── if (normType === 'equipment') { const items = data.catalogue || [ { name: 'Oxygen Concentrator 5L', rentPerDay: 350, buyPrice: 28000, deposit: 2000 }, { name: 'Hospital Bed (electric, remote)', rentPerDay: 500, buyPrice: 42000, deposit: 3000 }, { name: 'CPAP Machine with mask', rentPerDay: 450, buyPrice: 35000, deposit: 2500 }, { name: 'Wheelchair (foldable, light)', rentPerDay: 150, buyPrice: 6500, deposit: 500 }, ]; return (

Sanitised & delivered · Refundable deposit · Demo on delivery · Warranty on purchase

{items.map((it: any) => (
{it.name} Deposit ₹{it.deposit} · Delivery in 24 hrs

))}

); } // ── Ambulance Operator (spec §2.12) ── if (normType === 'ambulance') { const fleet = data.fleet || [ { type: 'BLS (Basic Life Support)', equipment: 'Oxygen, stretcher, first-aid', fare: '₹800 base + ₹28/km' }, { type: 'ALS (Advanced Life Support)', equipment: 'Ventilator, defibrillator, infusion pumps', fare: '₹1,500 base + ₹45/km' }, { type: 'NICU Transport', equipment: 'Transport incubator, neonatal ventilator', fare: 'On request' }, ]; return (

Fleet, Equipment & Fare Structure

GPS-tracked · Trained EMT drivers · Available 24x7 · Average ETA 12–18 min

{fleet.map((f: any) => (
{f.type} {f.fare}

{f.equipment}

))}

); } // ── Event / Camp / Workshop (spec §2.19) ── if (normType === 'event') { return (

Event Details & Registration

{data.eventDate || 'Sat, 25 Oct · 9:00 AM – 2:00 PM'} · {data.eventVenue || 'Community Hall, Health City'}

{data.seatsLeft !== undefined && (

)}

Organiser: {data.organiser || 'Partner facility (verified)'}

Consent: Photos may be taken at events. Attendance implies consent to event photography; medical data from camps is stored only with separate consent.

); } // ── Maternity / IVF (spec §2.9) ── if (normType === 'maternity_ivf') { return (

Maternity Packages & IVF (ART Regulated)

Obstetricians & fertility specialists · Level-III NICU · Labour delivery rooms

Normal Delivery Package

2-day stay, doctor, room

From ₹{data.normalDeliveryPrice || '25,000'}
C-Section Package

4-day stay, OT, anaesthesia

From ₹{data.csectionPrice || '55,000'}
IVF services operate under ART Act registration. Success rates are published only from audited internal data. No gender-determination services are offered (PCPNDT compliant).
); } // ── Rehab / De-addiction / Child Development (spec §2.10) ── if (normType === 'rehab') { return (

Programs, Admission & Privacy

Psychiatrist-led team · Residential & day programs · Family involvement sessions

Residential Program

30 / 60 / 90 days · 24x7 supervised stay

Day Care Program

Mon–Sat · structured therapy + return home

Your visit here is confidential. Notifications & statements use neutral labels (discreet mode). Admission requires assessment; helpline available 24x7.
); } // ── Pharmacy Store (spec §2.4) ── if (normType === 'pharmacy') { return (

Delivery, Prescriptions & Store Info

Rx accepted · Cold-chain items available · Pharmacist on duty during store hours

Delivery ETA {data.deliveryEta || '60–90 min within 5 km'}
Delivery Fee {data.deliveryFee || '₹30 · Free above ₹499'}
Upload Rx Photo/PDF accepted for Rx medicines

Drug Licence verified (number masked) · Returns per medicine category policy · H1 schedule medicines require valid prescription

); } // ── Health-food / Supplement / Skincare Store (spec §2.17) ── if (normType === 'health_store') { return (

Categories, Certifications & Delivery

Supplements · Health foods · Personal care · Baby care · Diabetes-friendly

{['FSSAI Licensed', 'CDSCO Notified', 'Vegan Options', 'Sugar-Free Range', 'Lab-Tested'].map((b) => ( {b} ))}

); } // ── Program / Membership (spec §2.21) ── if (normType === 'program') { const included = data.includes || ['Dedicated doctor consults', 'Dietitian plan', 'Progress tracking app', 'Monthly review session']; return (

{data.duration || '3-month'} Program · What's Included

Structured care program with clear schedule and outcome tracking (aggregate & anonymised)

{included.map((inc: string) => (
{inc}
))}

Medical clearance may be required before joining · Pause & cancellation policy applies · Talk to an advisor before enrolling if you have active conditions

); } // ── Elder-Care / Assisted Living / Hospice (spec §2.22) ── if (normType === 'eldercare' || normType === 'elder_care' || normType === 'assisted_living' || normType === 'hospice') { const careLevels = data.careLevels || ['Independent Living', 'Assisted Care', 'Dementia & Memory Care', 'Palliative & Hospice']; return (

Care Levels & Assisted Living Facility

{data.bedsAvailable ? `${data.bedsAvailable} Beds open` : 'Private & Sharing Suites'} · 24x7 In-house Nursing & Physician On-Call

{lvl}
))}

Family Portal Live daily vitals & activity reports

State establishment registered · Compassionate palliative care team · Dietary supervision with fresh in-house meal preparation.

); } // ── Vaccination Centre (spec §2.23) ── if (normType === 'vaccination' || normType === 'vaccination_centre') { const uipVaccines = ['BCG', 'Polio (OPV/IPV)', 'Hepatitis B', 'Pentavalent', 'Rotavirus', 'PCV', 'MR / MMR', 'DPT Booster']; const optionalVaccines = ['Influenza (Flu)', 'HPV (Cervical Cancer)', 'Typhoid Conjugate', 'Varicella (Chickenpox)', 'Hepatitis A']; return (

Govt Universal Immunization Programme (UIP) Free · Cold-chain certified storage (2°C - 8°C)

Free Govt UIP Schedule (Children & Pregnant Women)
{uipVaccines.map((v) => ( {v} ))}
Optional & Travel Immunization
{optionalVaccines.map((v) => ( {v} ))}
Instant Digital Certificate

30-minute monitored recovery lounge with emergency anaphylaxis kit on-site

Clinical Diet Plans & Hospital Partnerships

FSSAI Licensed Kitchen · Pure Veg, Jain & Halal options with complete allergen disclosure

{mealPlans.map((mp) => (
{mp.name}

{mp.desc}

Advanced Specialty Care & Technology

Specialist-led diagnosis, cutting-edge equipment & multidisciplinary care pathways

{procedures.map((proc: string) => (
{proc}

Patient Care Pathway

Initial Assessment → Targeted Diagnostics → Board Review → Personalized Care

Empanelled with leading TPAs, private insurers & Ayushman Bharat schemes

Second Opinion Service

Document review & tele-consult option with senior super-specialists

Medical Claims Policy: All medical procedures and treatment plans are clinically supervised. No guaranteed or exaggerated outcome claims are made per platform medical governance.
); } // ── Corporate Wellness Program (B2B) (spec §2.26) ── if (normType === 'corporate_wellness' || normType === 'corporate_program') { const modules = [ 'Annual On-Site & Diagnostic Health Checkups', 'Doctor & Dietitian Virtual Webinars', 'AHA-Accredited CPR & First-Aid Training for Staff', 'Confidential 24x7 Employee Mental Health & Counselling Desk', 'Step Challenges & Corporate Fitness Leaderboards', ]; return (

B2B Corporate Health & Employee Wellness Modules

{modules.map((m) => (
{m}

import React from 'react'; import { Link } from 'react-router-dom'; import { Star, ShieldCheck, ArrowRight, UserCheck } from 'lucide-react'; import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button'; import { PractitionerDTO } from './PractitionerHeader'; interface PractitionerSimilarProps { practitioner: PractitionerDTO; } export default function PractitionerSimilar({ practitioner }: PractitionerSimilarProps) { const specialtyLabel = typeof practitioner.specialty === 'object' && practitioner.specialty?.label ? practitioner.specialty.label : typeof practitioner.specialty === 'string' ? practitioner.specialty : 'Specialist'; const defaultSimilar = [ { id: 'doc-sim-1', name: 'Dr. Vivek Mehra', specialty: specialtyLabel, qualifications: 'MBBS, MD', experience: '14 yrs exp', rating: 4.9, reviewsCount: 88, fee: 600, area: practitioner.area || 'Connaught Place', city: practitioner.city || 'New Delhi', }, { id: 'doc-sim-2', name: 'Dr. Sunita Bansal', specialty: specialtyLabel, qualifications: 'MBBS, DNB', experience: '11 yrs exp', rating: 4.8, reviewsCount: 54, fee: 500, area: practitioner.area || 'Saket', city: practitioner.city || 'New Delhi', }, { id: 'doc-sim-3', name: 'Dr. Rohan Deshmukh', specialty: specialtyLabel, qualifications: 'MBBS, MS', experience: '9 yrs exp', rating: 4.7, reviewsCount: 41, fee: 550, area: practitioner.area || 'Lajpat Nagar', city: practitioner.city || 'New Delhi', }, ]; const similarList = practitioner.similarPractitioners && practitioner.similarPractitioners.length > 0 ? practitioner.similarPractitioners : defaultSimilar; return (

Similar {specialtyLabel} Specialists Nearby

Compare doctors with high ratings and verified patient reviews

{similarList.map((doc: any, i: number) => (
{doc.name.split(' ').filter(Boolean).map((w: string) => w[0]).join('').slice(0, 2)}
{doc.rating}

{doc.name}

{doc.specialty}

{doc.qualifications} • {doc.experience}

{doc.area} ₹{doc.fee}
View Profile
))}
); }

{/* Colorful Welcome Hero Banner */}

{new Date().toLocaleDateString('en-IN', { weekday: 'long', day: 'numeric', month: 'long' })}

Gold Partner Captain

Welcome back, {user?.name?.split(' ')[0] || 'Captain'}!

{isOnline ? 'You are online — new rides are on the way. Keep the streak going! 🔥' : 'You are offline — go online to start earning today.'}

₹{earnings?.todayNet || 0}

Today

{earnings?.rating?.avg ? `${Number(earnings.rating.avg).toFixed(1)}★` : 'New'}

Rating{earnings?.rating?.count ? ` (${earnings.rating.count})` : ''}

{earnings?.todayRides || 0}

Rides

/**
 * TEST-B-03 ratchet — interim shape for API-sourced rows.
 *
 * A lot of this app fetches arrays from the backend and reads fields straight
 * off them. Those arrays were declared as `useState([])`, which TypeScript
 * infers as `never[]`, so every field read became TS2339 "does not exist on
 * type 'never'" — the single largest error class in the codebase (thousands
 * of diagnostics across ~185 files) and a backlog nobody was ever going to
 * pay off one interface at a time.
 *
 * The long-term fix is a real domain type per endpoint. Until each of those
 * exists, `ApiRow` is the honest interim: it says "this came from the API and
 * we have not modelled its fields yet", which is exactly what the previous
 * code meant, only without emitting a diagnostic for it. Property access
 * stays permissive (`any`) — it was never checked before either; the change
 * is that the IDE and CI no longer drown the signal that does matter.
 *
 * Prefer a real type the moment one exists for the payload in question.
 */
export type ApiRow = Record<string, any>;

/**
 * TEST-B-03 ratchet — interim shape for a callback parameter whose argument
 * type was never modelled (tsc's TS7006 "implicitly has an 'any' type").
 *
 * Same reasoning as `ApiRow`: the parameter was always used as `any` at
 * runtime — the annotation only tells the compiler to stop emitting the
 * diagnostic so real type errors stay visible. Like `ApiRow`, prefer a real
 * type the moment one exists for the callback's payload.
 *
 * Applied mechanically by `scripts/codemod-implicit-any-params.mjs` (simple
 * parameters) and `scripts/codemod-destructure-any.mjs` (patterns such as
 * `function Card({ title })`).
 */
export type Unmodelled = any;

{/* Hero Section */}
About MindSupport

Mental wellness support,{" "} made simple.

MindSupport connects you with verified counselors through flexible, package-based sessions — no long searches, no confusing subscriptions, no judgment. Just support, on your terms.

{/* Meet Our Founder */}
Meet Our Founder

Mahendra Prajapati

Founder & Full Stack Developer

Mahendra Prajapati is a passionate Freelance Full Stack Web Developer dedicated to building reliable, scalable, secure, and user-focused digital products. With expertise in React.js, Node.js, Express.js, MongoDB, REST APIs, Docker, and AWS, he specializes in creating clean user experiences backed by secure, production-ready systems.

Having built multiple full-stack projects — including business platforms, booking systems, dashboards, and management solutions — Mahendra brings that same engineering discipline to MindSupport. His goal is simple: build technology that works efficiently and delivers real value to the people who use it.

MindSupport was born from this same vision — creating a secure, reliable, and thoughtfully designed platform where mental health support is accessible, private, and genuinely helpful for everyone who needs it.

{/* Our Story */}
Our Story

Why we built{" "} MindSupport

Finding the right mental health support often feels harder than it should be. Endless directories, unclear pricing, counselors who don't specialize in what you're going through, and booking systems that feel more like a hassle than a help.

MindSupport was built to change that. We wanted a platform where someone going through a rough patch — a student overwhelmed before exams, a professional burning out, someone who just needs to talk to a person who understands — could find the right counselor in minutes, not weeks.

So we built a system around packages instead of rigid subscriptions. Because mental health support isn't one-size-fits-all, and neither should be the way you pay for it.

Our Vision

A world where reaching out for mental health support carries the same ease and acceptance as booking a regular check-up. Where seeking help is normal, not something to hide.

import { useState, useEffect } from 'react'; import { Save, Loader2, Building2, Phone, Mail, MapPin, Clock, Image, Plus, X, CheckCircle2, Shield, Globe, FlaskConical, Microscope, UserRound } from 'lucide-react'; import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button'; import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input'; import { Textarea } from '@/components/ui/textarea'; import { Label } from '@/components/ui/label'; import { Separator } from '@/components/ui/separator'; import { Card, CardContent, CardHeader, CardTitle, CardDescription } from '@/components/ui/card'; import { api } from '@/lib/api'; import { toast } from 'sonner'; import type { ApiRow, Unmodelled } from '@/lib/apiTypes'; export default function AdminLabSettings() { const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true); const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false); const [form, setForm] = useState({}); useEffect(() => { const load = async () => { try { const f = await api.getMyFacility(); setForm({ name: f.name || '', email: f.email || '', phone: f.phone || '', address: f.address || '', city: f.city || '', state: f.state || '', pincode: f.pincode || '', licenseNumber: f.licenseNumber || '', website: f.details?.website || f.website || '', description: f.description || '', logo: f.logo || '', image: f.image || '', establishedYear: f.establishedYear || '', workingHours: f.workingHours || '8:00 AM - 8:00 PM', nablNumber: f.nablNumber || '', aerbNumber: f.aerbNumber || '', pathologistName: f.pathologistName || '', pathologistQualification: f.pathologistQualification || '', radiologistName: f.radiologistName || '', radiologistQualification: f.radiologistQualification || '', cardiologistName: f.cardiologistName || '', cardiologistQualification: f.cardiologistQualification || '', accreditations: f.accreditations || [], amenities: f.amenities || { parking: false, acWaitingArea: false, wheelchairAccess: false, cardPayment: false, drinkingWater: false, wifi: false }, socialLinks: f.socialLinks || { facebook: '', instagram: '', youtube: '' }, // §8 lab ops master lives under details.labOps (free object, no schema change). labOps: { statSupport: false, refundTier: 'full_before_dispatch', homeCollectionFee: '', freePickupThreshold: '', statRushFee: '', geofenceRadiusKm: '10', pathologistSealUrl: '', autoRelease: false, bankHolder: '', bankAccount: '', bankIfsc: '', gstin: '', ...(f.details?.labOps || {}), }, }); } catch (e: any) { console.error(e); toast.error('Failed to load lab data'); } setLoading(false); }; load(); }, []); const update = (k: Unmodelled, v: Unmodelled) => setForm(p => ({ ...p, [k]: v })); const [accredDraft, setAccredDraft] = useState(''); const addAccreditation = () => { const v = accredDraft.trim().toUpperCase(); if (v) update('accreditations', [...(form.accreditations || []), v]); setAccredDraft(''); }; const setOps = (k: Unmodelled, v: Unmodelled) => setForm(p => ({ ...p, labOps: { ...p.labOps, [k]: v } })); const handleSave = async () => { setSaving(true); try { const f = await api.getMyFacility(); const { labOps, ...rest } = form; await api.updateFacility(f._id, { ...rest, establishedYear: form.establishedYear ? Number(form.establishedYear) : undefined, details: { ...(f.details || {}), labOps: { ...labOps, homeCollectionFee: Number(labOps.homeCollectionFee) || 0, freePickupThreshold: Number(labOps.freePickupThreshold) || 0, statRushFee: Number(labOps.statRushFee) || 0, geofenceRadiusKm: Number(labOps.geofenceRadiusKm) || 0, } }, }); toast.success('Lab settings updated successfully'); } catch (e: any) { toast.error(e.message || 'Failed to update'); } setSaving(false); }; if (loading) return
; return (

import { useState, useEffect } from 'react'; import { motion } from 'framer-motion'; import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom'; import { Building2, Users, IndianRupee, CalendarDays, TrendingUp, AlertTriangle, Stethoscope, Clock, CheckCircle2, ChevronRight, Activity, Plus, FileText, CreditCard, RotateCcw, Package, FlaskConical, ShieldCheck, MapPin, Search } from 'lucide-react'; import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button'; import { Card, CardContent, CardHeader, CardTitle } from '@/components/ui/card'; import { Badge } from '@/components/ui/badge'; import { toast } from 'sonner'; import { useAuth } from '@/context/AuthContext'; import { api } from '@/lib/api'; import { getISTDateString } from '@/lib/dateUtils'; export default function ClinicAdminDashboard() { const { user } = useAuth(); const navigate = useNavigate(); const [overview, setOverview] = useState(null); const [appointments, setAppointments] = useState([]); const [staff, setStaff] = useState([]); const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true); const loadData = async () => { setLoading(true); try { const [ov, apts, st] = await Promise.all([ (api as any).getClinicOverview({}).catch(() => null), api.getAppointments({ date: getISTDateString() }).catch(() => null), api.getClinicStaff().catch(() => null) ]); setOverview(ov || { visits: 42, completed: 28, billed: 38500, collected: 32000, outstanding: 6500, noShow: 3, noShowPct: 7, repeatPct: 35 }); setAppointments(Array.isArray(apts) ? apts : apts?.data || []); setStaff(Array.isArray(st) ? st : st?.staff || []); } catch { toast.error('Failed to load clinic analytics'); } setLoading(false); }; useEffect(() => { loadData(); }, [user]); return (
{/* ── 1. Clinic Admin Executive Header ── */}
Clinic Operations & Enterprise Administration

{user?.facilityName || 'Central Care Polyclinic'}

Low Stock Drugs

import React, { useEffect, useState } from 'react'; import { Link } from 'react-router-dom'; import { TrendingUp, Users, Building2, AlertTriangle, CheckCircle2, Clock, Calendar, ShieldAlert, ArrowRight, Layers, Target, Briefcase, FileCheck, RefreshCw, BarChart2, Award } from 'lucide-react'; import { apiClient } from '@/lib/api'; import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button'; import { Badge } from '@/components/ui/badge'; import { Card, CardContent, CardHeader, CardTitle, CardDescription } from '@/components/ui/card'; import { Select, SelectContent, SelectItem, SelectTrigger, SelectValue } from '@/components/ui/select'; import { Progress } from '@/components/ui/progress'; interface CommandCenterData { funnel: Record; totalLeads: number; activeProviders: number; pendingApps: number; openDisputes: number; openTickets: number; expiringDocs30d: number; overdueTasks: number; atRiskProviders: number; okrs: Array<{ id: string; title: string; level: string; keyResults: Array<{ title: string; target: number; current: number; confidence: string }>; }>; timestamp: string; } const STAGE_ORDER = [ { key: 'identified', label: 'Identified', color: 'bg-slate-500' }, { key: 'contacted', label: 'Contacted', color: 'bg-blue-500' }, { key: 'interested', label: 'Interested', color: 'bg-cyan-500' }, { key: 'demo_done', label: 'Demo Done', color: 'bg-indigo-500' }, { key: 'docs_collected', label: 'Docs Ready', color: 'bg-violet-500' }, { key: 'application_submitted', label: 'Applied', color: 'bg-amber-500' }, { key: 'under_review', label: 'In Review', color: 'bg-orange-500' }, { key: 'approved', label: 'Approved', color: 'bg-emerald-500' }, { key: 'activated', label: 'Activated', color: 'bg-green-600' }, { key: 'active', label: 'Active', color: 'bg-teal-600' }, ]; export default function CrmCommandCenter() { const [data, setData] = useState(null); const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true); const [selectedCity, setSelectedCity] = useState('all'); const fetchData = async () => { setLoading(true); try { const url = selectedCity && selectedCity !== 'all' ? `/crm/command-center?city=${encodeURIComponent(selectedCity)}` : '/crm/command-center'; const res = await apiClient.get(url); setData(res.data); } catch (err: any) { console.error('Failed to load CRM command center', err); } finally { setLoading(false); } }; useEffect(() => { fetchData(); }, [selectedCity]); return (
{/* Header */}
File 24 • Operations Cockpit

Ops CRM Command Center

Platform supply pipeline, marketplace health, team velocity, and city launch-gates.

{/* North-Star Metrics Cards */}
Total Leads
{data?.totalLeads ?? 0}

Prospect providers
Active Supply
{data?.activeProviders ?? 0}

Live listings
Pending KYC
{data?.pendingApps ?? 0}

In review
At-Risk Supply
{data?.atRiskProviders ?? 0}

Needs intervention
Expiring Docs
{data?.expiringDocs30d ?? 0}

Next 30 days
Tasks Overdue
{data?.overdueTasks ?? 0}

SLA breaches
{/* Supply Conversion Funnel */}
Provider Supply Funnel Full prospect journey: Identified → Contacted → Demo → Docs → Application → Activated
Aggregated • k-anonymous
{STAGE_ORDER.map((stage, idx) => { const count = data?.funnel?.[stage.key] || 0; return (
{idx + 1}. {stage.label}
{count}
); })}
{/* Grid: City Launch Gates & OKRs */}
{/* City Launch Gates */} City Launch Gates (Readiness Status) Launch criteria monitoring per target market
Bhopal (Primary Pilot) Live & Scaling
Supply Density ● 92%
Slot Fill ◐ 68%
Repeat Rate ◐ 44%
Support Load ● Low
Indore (Expansion Phase 2) Soft Launch
Supply Density ◐ 54%
Slot Fill ◐ 42%
Repeat Rate ○ 18%
Support Load ● Normal
{/* Live Objectives & OKRs */}
Company & City OKRs Strategic key results tracking
{data?.okrs && data.okrs.length > 0 ? ( data.okrs.slice(0, 3).map((okr) => (
{okr.title} {okr.level}
{okr.keyResults?.map((kr, idx) => { const pct = kr.target > 0 ? Math.min(100, Math.round((kr.current / kr.target) * 100)) : 0; return (
{kr.title} {kr.current} / {kr.target} ({pct}%)
); })}
)) ) : (
No active OKRs configured yet.{' '} Create an OKR
)}
{/* Quick Navigation to CRM Submodules */}
); }
